thread:
Celine (Finance): Quick request: Skara Med (EMEA channel partner) is asking for a short-term concession to win a hospital pilot. Ask: 12% usage credit on partner-billed usage + Net60 for 4 months. They also want VAT passthrough. Need deal-desk sign-off and CFO OK.

Omar (Sales): Short context: target is 3 hospital sites in NL/BE, pilot 4 months starting 2026-09-01. Volume estimate ~150k tokens/month ramping to 420k. Partner says this concession is required to offset their integration costs.

Ravi (RevOps): Ops guardrails: (1) cap aggregate credit at EUR 10,000, (2) credit only applies to partner master account mapping to specific end-customers, (3) clawback if end-customer cancels within 90 days of first billed month (prorated). We'll need a Zuora config for a "partner_pilot_credit" charge and holdback rule.

Leah (Legal): Draft addendum OK. Need: formal definition of "usage credit", exact cap, clawback formula, VAT reps & audit right. Also require reseller to provide valid VAT ID + OSS proof before any 0% VAT invoice issued.

Edda (CFO): Net60 increases DSO; conditional approval only. Require a 30-50% holdback on credit ledger until month 2 depending on credit check. Also want a trade ref + basic credit check completed.

Omar (Sales): Skara provided VAT ID and two trade refs via email (attached to deal SKR-511). They asked for invoices in EUR to match collections.

Celine (Finance): Accounting note: treat credits as contra-revenue, release monthly across pilot. Ravi, can Zuora do automated ledger cap + holdback?

Ravi (RevOps): Yes. I'll open ticket ZOA-9405 to create `partner_pilot_credit` charge type, set recognition to monthly release, and implement a default 40% holdback unless CFO requests otherwise. Linking to deal SKR-511.

Leah (Legal): Draft addendum created and uploaded to the deal. Key terms: 12% credit up to EUR10k total, pilot 2026-09-01 to 2026-12-01, clawback within 90 days prorated, reseller VAT reps required. Sending to Omar for signature routing.

billing-bot: ZOA-9405 created and assigned to billing-team. Note added to SKR-511: "partner pilot credit 12% cap EUR10k, Net60 pending CFO holdback, VAT docs received".

Edda (CFO): Conditional approval: proceed if (1) signed addendum, (2) ZOA-9405 with 40% holdback implemented, (3) trade refs checked. If any of those fail, revert to Net30.

Celine (Finance): Approve in principle pending those 3 checks. Final approval will be posted here when confirmed.

Omar (Sales): I'll get the signed addendum back within 48h and post trade-ref screenshots. Thanks team :rocket:

Leah (Legal): One more item: include a short audit window (12 months) so we can verify partner reporting. Adding that to the addendum now.

Ravi (RevOps): Noted. ZOA-9405 will include mapping to partner account + audit flag.

Celine (Finance): Tagging for monthly approvals board. Keep updates to this thread only.
